title: internal/cli's TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo assumes no ticfac-exec-subprocess on PATH
body: The test builds the ticfac binary and asserts run-epic refuses with exit 2 and "no executor configured", but reconcile.CheckExecutor also looks the supervisor binary up on PATH — on an operator machine with ticfac-exec-subprocess installed (~/.local/bin here) the check passes, the run proceeds to read a nonexistent gate config, and the test fails with exit 1. Reproduced at be3b46ba; CI is green because its PATH is clean. The test needs a PATH scrub for the child, or the refusal needs to prefer os.Executable's directory only in tests.
